methods.estimand: exp(mean per-round log(candidate/reference lifecycle)) conditional on both primary observations succeeding
methods.lifecycleDefinition: inputPreparationMs (zero when not applicable) + confirmationMs + postReceiptToValidatedPlaintextMs, summed per observation before descriptive statistics; transaction estimation/signing and intentional barrier waits excluded
methods.nullHypothesis: Mean paired log ratio = 0 (geometric mean paired ratio = 1), two-sided
methods.bootstrap: Circular moving blocks within each original/continuation segment, fixed observed sample count per segment; same paired ratio observations resampled
methods.confidenceInterval: Pointwise 95% basic bootstrap interval on mean log-ratio, exponentiated; not Holm-adjusted
methods.rawP: Two-sided equal-tail null-centered block-bootstrap test: min(1, 2*(min(upper,lower)+1)/(B+1)); centered replicate=bootstrap log-mean minus observed log-mean
methods.multiplicity: Holm step-down across all 15 operation/comparison hypotheses in both tables. Separate 10/5 corrections are stored only as secondary diagnostics.
methods.assumptions: Exploratory conditional inference. Requires approximate stationarity and sufficiently weak temporal dependence within each segment. Stratification fixes segment mix and does not eliminate network confounding or outcome-dependent missingness.
methods.interpretation: These are public-network client lifecycle ratios, not pure FHE execution, causal overhead, uninterrupted-campaign results, or claims about the timed-out observation.
